name: Fruit Storm
summary:
Fruit is raining from the orchard trees. Catch it with your bare hands, sort it by color and toss it into the right basket!
Catch with your hands: open your palm toward a fruit and it lands in your hand. Two-handed catches and overhead shots work too.
Real throwing physics: lob it, line-drive it, bank it off the rim. Nail it without touching the rim for a SWISH!
Chain three baskets in a row and you're ON FIRE: your throws leave a trail of flames.
